42068-the-tyranny-of-tears-a-comedy-in-f.title: The Tyranny Of Tears A Comedy In Four Acts
42068-the-tyranny-of-tears-a-comedy-in-f.creator: C. Haddon Chambers
42068-the-tyranny-of-tears-a-comedy-in-f.description: A book by C. Haddon Chambers. ; it is a triumph of the commonplace. Played virtually by five characters, and with but one change of scene, it has that specious appearance of ease which is due to dexterity of craftsmanship.

arxiv-2011-09545.title: MOFA: Modular Factorial Design for Hyperparameter Optimization Work done as an internship at Huawei Noah’s Ark Lab
arxiv-2011-09545.creator: Bo Xiong, Yimin Huang, Hanrong Ye, Steffen Staab, Zhenguo Li
arxiv-2011-09545.description: Abstract This paper presents a novel and lightweight hyperparameter optimization (HPO) method, MOdular FActorial Design (MOFA). MOFA pursues several rounds of HPO, where each round alternates between exploration of hyperparameter space by factorial design and exploitation of evaluation results by factorial analysis .

arxiv-2107-05062.title: Time-dependent study of 𝑲 𝑺 → 𝝅 + ​ 𝝅 − K_{S}\to\pi^{+}\pi^{-} decays for flavour physics measurements
arxiv-2107-05062.creator: P. Pakhlov, V. Popov
arxiv-2107-05062.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by P. Pakhlov, V. Popov. Nowadays High Energy Physics experiments can accumulate unprecedented statistics of heavy flavour decays that allows to apply new methods, based on the study of very rare phenomena, which used to be just desperate. In this paper we propose a new method to measure composition of K 0 K^{0} - K ¯ 0 \overline{K}{}^{0} , produced in a decay of heavy hadrons.

arxiv-2107-12321.title: MAG-Net: Multi-task attention guided network for brain tumor segmentation and classification Thanks: All authors have contributed equally. Affiliation: Indian Institute of Information Technology Allahabad, India
arxiv-2107-12321.creator: Sachin Gupta, Narinder Singh Punn, Sanjay Kumar Sonbhadra, Sonali Agarwal
arxiv-2107-12321.description: Abstract Brain tumor is the most common and deadliest disease that can be found in all age groups. Generally, MRI modality is adopted for identifying and diagnosing tumors by the radiologists. The correct identification of tumor regions and its type can aid to diagnose tumors with the followup treatment plans.

arxiv-2111-01302.title: Differential Flatness and Flatness Inspired Control of Aerial Manipulators based on Lagrangian Reduction
arxiv-2111-01302.creator: Skylar X. Wei, Peder Hårderup, Joel W. Burdick
arxiv-2111-01302.description: Abstract This paper shows that the dynamics of a general class of aerial manipulators, consist of an underactuated multi-rotor base with an arbitrary k-linked articulated manipulator, are differentially flat. Methods of Lagrangian Reduction under broken symmetries produce reduced equations of motion whose key variables: center-of-mass linear momentum, vehicle yaw angle, and manipulator relative joint angles become the flat outputs.

arxiv-2204-14136.title: Towards Automatic Parsing of Structured Visual Content through the Use of Synthetic Data
arxiv-2204-14136.creator: Lukas Schölch 1, Jonas Steinhäuser 1, Maximilian Beichter 1, Constantin Seibold 2, Kailun Yang 2
arxiv-2204-14136.description: Abstract Structured Visual Content (SVC) such as graphs, flow charts, or the like are used by authors to illustrate various concepts. While such depictions allow the average reader to better understand the contents, images containing SVCs are typically not machine-readable. This, in turn, not only hinders automated knowledge aggregation, but also the perception of displayed information for visually impaired people.

arxiv-2307-04746.title: Classical Observables from the Exponential Representation of the Gravitational S-Matrix Preprint: CERN-TH-2023-135, IPhT-T23/041, LAPTh-029/23
arxiv-2307-04746.creator: ​​ Poul H. Damgaard, ​​, Elias Roos Hansen, ​​, Ludovic Planté, ​​, Pierre Vanhove
arxiv-2307-04746.description: Abstract By combining the KMOC-formalism with the exponential representation of the scattering matrix we show that the two-body scattering angle is given by the corresponding matrix element of the exponential representation. This holds to all orders in the Post-Minkowskian expansion of gravity when restricted to the conservative sector.

arxiv-2309-06135.title: Prompting4Debugging: Red-Teaming Text-to-Image Diffusion Models by Finding Problematic Prompts
arxiv-2309-06135.creator: Zhi-Yi Chin, Chieh-Ming Jiang, Ching-Chun Huang, Pin-Yu Chen, Wei-Chen Chiu
arxiv-2309-06135.description: Abstract Text-to-image diffusion models, e.g. Stable Diffusion (SD), lately have shown remarkable ability in high-quality content generation, and become one of the representatives for the recent wave of transformative AI. Nevertheless, such advance comes with an intensifying concern about the misuse of this generative technology, especially for producing copyrighted or NSFW (i.e. not safe for work) images.

arxiv-2312-00120.title: Persistence of the Pattern in the Interior of 5d Moduli Spaces
arxiv-2312-00120.creator: Tom Rudelius
arxiv-2312-00120.description: Abstract Castellano, Ruiz, and Valenzuela recently observed a remarkable “pattern” in infinite-distance limits of moduli spaces in quantum gravity, which relates the field space variation of the mass of the lightest tower of particles to the field space variation of the species scale.

arxiv-2408-16060.title: The Remarkable X-ray Spectra and Variability of the Ultraluminous Weak-Line Quasar SDSS J1521+5202
arxiv-2408-16060.creator: Shouyi Wang, W. N. Brandt, Bin Luo, Zhibo Yu, Fan Zou, Jian Huang, Qingling Ni, Fabio Vito
arxiv-2408-16060.description: Abstract We present a focused X-ray and multiwavelength study of the ultraluminous weak-line quasar (WLQ) SDSS J1521+5202, one of the few X-ray weak WLQs that is amenable to basic X-ray spectral and variability investigations. J1521+5202 shows striking X-ray variability during 2006–2023, by up to a factor of ≈ 32 \approx 32 in 0.

arxiv-2507-04708.title: Why We Feel What We Feel: Joint Detection of Emotions and Their Opinion Triggers in E-commerce
arxiv-2507-04708.creator: Arnav Attri, Anuj Attri, Pushpak Bhattacharyya, Suman Banerjee F {F}, Amey Patil F {F}, Muthusamy Chelliah F {F}, Nikesh Garera F {F}
arxiv-2507-04708.description: Abstract Customer reviews on e-commerce platforms capture critical affective signals that drive purchasing decisions. However, no existing research has explored the joint task of emotion detection and explanatory span identification in e-commerce reviews - a crucial gap in understanding what triggers customer emotional responses.

arxiv-2509-11937.title: MMORE: Massive Multimodal Open RAG & Extraction
arxiv-2509-11937.creator: Alexandre Sallinen, Stefan Krsteski, Paul Teiletche, Marc-Antoine Allard, Baptiste Lecoeur, Michael Zhang, David Kalajdzic, Matthias Meyer, Fabrice Nemo, Mary-Anne Hartley
arxiv-2509-11937.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Alexandre Sallinen, Stefan Krsteski, Paul Teiletche, Marc-Antoine Allard, Baptiste Lecoeur, Michael Zhang, David Kalajdzic, Matthias Meyer, Fabrice Nemo, Mary-Anne Hartley. We introduce MMORE , an open-source pipeline for M assive M ultimodal O pen R etrieval-Augmented Generation and E xtraction, designed to ingest, transform, and retrieve knowledge from heterogeneous document formats at scale. MMORE supports more than fifteen file types, including text, tables, images, emails, audio, and video, and processes them into a unified format to enable downstream applications for LLMs.

arxiv-2511-14850.title: Mid-infrared extinction toward the Galactic center Facilities: JWST, VLA astropy ( 6 ; 4 ; 5 ) , nifty.re8 ( 17 ; 2 ; 3 ; 19 ; 33 )
arxiv-2511-14850.creator: Sebastiano D. von Fellenberg, Joseph M. Michail, S. P. Willner, Braden Seefeldt-Gail, Tamojeet Roychowdhury, Macarena Garcia Marin, Giovanni G. Fazio, Nicole M. Ford, Daryl Haggard, Joseph L. Hora, Howard A. Smith, Zach Sumners, Gunther Witzel
arxiv-2511-14850.description: Abstract We determine the mid-infrared (MIR, ∼ \sim 5 µm–22 µm) extinction towards the Galactic center using MIRI/MRS integral field unit (IFU) observations of the central 3 ′′ × 3 ′′ 3^{\prime\prime}\times 3^{\prime\prime} region (near 5 µm) to 7 ′′ × 7 ′′ 7^{\prime\prime}\times 7^{\prime\prime} region (near 22 µm).

europmc-pmc7571423.creator: Travaglio M, Yu Y, Popovic R, Selley L, Leal NS, Martins LM.
europmc-pmc7571423.description: In December 2019, a novel disease, coronavirus disease 19 (COVID-19), emerged in Wuhan, People's Republic of China. COVID-19 is caused by a novel coronavirus (SARS-CoV-2) presumed to have jumped species from another mammal to humans. This virus has caused a rapidly spreading...

pmc-10475874.title: Diet composition and energy intake in humans
pmc-10475874.creator: R. James Stubbs, Graham Horgan, Eric Robinson, Mark Hopkins, Clarissa Dakin, Graham Finlayson
pmc-10475874.description: Absolute energy from fats and carbohydrates and the proportion of carbohydrates in the food supply have increased over 50 years. Dietary energy density (ED) is primarily decreased by the water and increased by the fat content of foods. Protein, carbohydrates and fat exert different effects on satiety or energy intake (EI) in the order protein > carbohydrates > fat.

pmc-10750351.title: Probing the underlying principles of dynamics in piano performances using a modelling approach
pmc-10750351.creator: Gabriel Jones, Anders Friberg
pmc-10750351.description: Variations in dynamics are an essential component of musical performance in most instruments. To study the factors that contribute to dynamic variations, we used a model approaching, allowing for determination of the individual contribution of different musical features. Thirty monophonic melodies from 3 stylistic eras with all expressive markings removed were performed by 20 pianists on a Disklavier piano.

pmc-10847260.title: Do VIP medical services damage efficiency? New evidence of medical institutions’ total factor productivity using Chinese panel data
pmc-10847260.creator: Yan Yang, Mingwang Cheng, Ning Chen, Ling Yuan, Zhaoxin Wang
pmc-10847260.description: This study examines the causal impact of very important person (VIP) medical services on hospital total factor productivity in Deyang, a prefectural-level city in western China, spanning the years 2015–2020. This aims to offer empirical evidence and policy recommendations for the implementation of VIP practices in the medical field.

pmc-11479329.title: Analysis of Inverter Efficiency Using Photovoltaic Power Generation Element Parameters
pmc-11479329.creator: Su-Chang Lim, Byung-Gyu Kim, Jong-Chan Kim
pmc-11479329.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Photovoltaic power generation is influenced not only by variable environmental factors, such as solar radiation, temperature, and humidity, but also by the condition of equipment, including solar modules and inverters. In order to preserve energy production, it is essential to maintain and operate the equipment in optimal condition, which makes it crucial to determine the condition of the equipment in advance.

pmc-11594965.title: Over-the-Wire Retrieval of Infectious Hemodialysis Catheter-Related Right Atrial Thrombus Causing Recurrent Pleural Empyema and Sepsis: A Case-Based Review
pmc-11594965.creator: Giuseppe Barilaro, Amedeo Galassi, Maria Chiara Gatto, Giulia Ciocci, Fabrizia Paola Fabrizio, Alessandra Cappelli
pmc-11594965.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Introduction: Infectious catheter-related right atrial thrombus (CRAT) is a potentially fatal but often underestimated contingency associated with central venous catheter (CVC) in patients on hemodialysis. Management guidelines for CRAT are lacking, and its occurrence poses clinical challenges. Here, we describe the case of an infectious CRAT in a young patient on hemodialysis with peculiar clinical complications and perform a literature review.

pmc-11633260.title: A peculiar presentation of mirtazapine-induced melasma: A very rare case report
pmc-11633260.creator: Sriparno Patra, Soumitra Ghosh, Rupa Gohain
pmc-11633260.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). igmentation,[34] although mirtazapine-induced melasma was not mentioned. In this context, we present a case of a 40-year-old married lady from a lower-middle-class family admitted to the Psychiatry department of Assam Medical College and Hospital. She had experienced depression for 3 years but sought psychiatric help due to worsening symptoms, including low mood, crying spells, early awakening, and inability to maintain daily activities.

pmc-11646659.title: Implementation of the REPRISE care bundle model for the prevention of pressure ulcers in an intensive care unit: An experimental study
pmc-11646659.creator: Zeynep Cor, Ganime Esra Soysal
pmc-11646659.description: The aim of this study was to evaluate the effectiveness of the REPRISE care bundle (CB) model for pressure ulcer (PU) prevention in intensive care patients and to determine the impact of the training provided to nurses on their knowledge base and attitudes. This study has an experimental design.

pmc-12575970.title: Machine learning applications in sports injury prediction: A narrative review
pmc-12575970.creator: Jin Yuan, Quanwen Zeng, Jun Li, Zhengzhou Cong, Yong Zhang
pmc-12575970.description: In recent years, machine learning (ML) has been increasingly applied to sports injury prediction, offering potential support for the early identification of risk and the optimization of preventive strategies. However, current studies face several key challenges, including the absence of standardized model development procedures and inconsistencies in data preprocessing, feature selection, and model evaluation across investigations.

pmc-13086952.title: A parameter estimation method for modelling proton exchange membrane fuel cell based on enhanced meta evolutionary differential evolution algorithm
pmc-13086952.creator: Vivekananda Pattanaik, Shubhranshu Mohan Parida, Binaya Kumar Malika, Pravat Kumar Rout, Binod Kumar Sahu, Jyoti Ranjan Padhi
pmc-13086952.description: Accurate estimation of unknown parameters in proton exchange membrane fuel cells (PEMFCs) is crucial for developing a precise and reliable model, which is necessary for further investigation, simulation analysis, and optimal control. However, conventional approaches often fail to provide satisfactory results due to high non-linearity, multi-variable nature, and strong nonconvexity associated with these problems.

pmc-13158628.title: Chronic Granulomatous Interstitial Nephritis Presenting Five Years After Intravesical Bacillus Calmette-Guérin Therapy: A Case Report and Literature Review
pmc-13158628.creator: Mehdi El Mansouri, Hanane Benali, Ismail Ait Elkihal, Nabil Hamouche, Mariam Chettati, Wafaa Fadili, Inass Laouad
pmc-13158628.description: Intravesical administration of Bacillus Calmette-Guérin (BCG) has been the standard treatment for non-muscle invasive bladder cancer (NMIBC). Its efficacy in preventing recurrence and tumor progression has been well established; however, rare immune-mediated complications, particularly parenchymal renal involvement, pose significant diagnostic challenges.

pmc-13241564.title: Correction: Epidemiology and Clinicopathologic Features with Prognostic Implications of Conventional Ameloblastoma: A 22-Year Retrospective Study
pmc-13241564.creator: Kittiphoj Tikkhanarak, Nidhi Handoo, John Hellstein, Tamara Busch, Aline Petrin, Erliang Zeng, Hongli Sun, Martine Dunnwald, Azeez Butali

pmc-13393245.title: Automated measurement of the minimum macular hole diameter based on optical coherence tomography images
pmc-13393245.creator: Jianguo Xu, Jiahao Wei, Rong Tan, Jianxin Shen, Jin Yao, Fen Zhou
pmc-13393245.description: BackgroundAccurate measurement of minimum macular hole (MH) diameter is essential for diagnosis and treatment. The manual measurement approach by ophthalmologists is time-consuming, poorly reproducible, and exhibits high inter-observer variability. Threshold-based methods are sensitive to image quality, and perform inadequately in low-contrast optical coherence tomography (OCT) images. Deep learning can achieve higher measurement accuracy but shows limited generalization capability.

pmc-13411408.title: Advances in Immunotherapy for Intrahepatic Cholangiocarcinoma
pmc-13411408.creator: Huimin Qi, Jialin Pan, Hailong Wu
pmc-13411408.description: Intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma (iCCA) is a highly lethal and heterogeneous primary liver malignancy with a dismal prognosis. Approximately 70% of patients are diagnosed at locally advanced or metastatic stages, therefore missing the opportunity for curative surgery, and conventional chemotherapy offers limited survival benefits.

pmc-13605472.title: Cariogenic Risk Modifies the Effect of Marginal Adaptation on Caries Adjacent to Posterior Composite Restorations: A Stratified Multivariate Analysis
pmc-13605472.creator: Andrei Georgescu, Sorin Andrian, Cristina-Angela Ghiorghe, Galina Pancu, Claudiu Topoliceanu, Ionuţ Tărăboanţă, Irina Nica, Răzvan Brânzan, Cristina Dascălu, Maria-Alexandra Mârţu, Mihaela Sălceanu
pmc-13605472.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Background/Objectives: Caries adjacent to restorations or sealants (CARS) is among the most frequent biological causes of composite restoration failure, resulting from the interplay between the patient’s cariogenic risk and restoration-related factors such as marginal adaptation. The study aimed to investigate whether cariogenic risk modifies the effect of marginal adaptation on the occurrence of caries adjacent to posterior composite restorations (CARS), using risk-stratified univariate analysis and a clustering-adjusted approach, to identify associated clinical, socio-demographic, and local risk factors.

uslaw-usc-t17-s903.title: 17 U.S.C. § 903 — Ownership, transfer, licensing, and recordation
uslaw-usc-t17-s903.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t17-s903.description: United States Code, Title 17 (Copyrights); Chapter 9 (Protection Of Semiconductor Chip Products). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) The exclusive rights in a mask work subject to protection under this chapter belong to the owner of the mask work. (b) The owner of the exclusive rights in a mask work may transfer all of those rights, or license all or less.
